candidates.description: Georgetown Hoyas and Princeton Tigers playing in the first round of the 1989 NCAA men's basketball tournament, with 1:41 left in the game at the Providence Civic Center in Providence, Rhode Island. Freshman Alonzo Mourning is at the free throw line, while coach John Thompson talks on the sideline to senior guard Charles Smith. Georgetown won the game 50-49.

candidates.description: Princeton jumped out to an early and improbable lead. Holding Georgetown to 4 points in the first 4 minutes? Impossible. Funny how lots of people were taking photos of the scoreboard - we all expected it to be Princeton's last lead. Taken at the 1989 Georgetown vs. Princeton men's basketball game at the Providence Civic Center in Providence, RI.
